name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: The field with addons inside it: icons, text, small buttons or a gray segment, sharing one border and focus.
usage: Put context inside a field: a search icon, a protocol or unit (https://, ms), a copy or show button, or a domain suffix as a segment. Use InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea as the control; addons go at inline-start, inline-end, block-start or block-end. A click on an addon focuses the field.
avoid: An addon that hides what the field contains
A blue border before the field has focus
